title: The Secret Exhibition
source_text: and now the silence is so complete / it could swallow a scream whole / and ask for more.
why: Two still bodies at opposite ends of a blank lit wall: a silence so complete it could swallow a scream. It states the film's contract as a feeling, and her definition of that silence answers it at 28.
what_we_see: Locked-off wide, a barely perceptible push-in toward the lit wall. A fine mist falls through the spotlight cone and glitters as it drifts down. The broken-white pool of light on the wall slowly breathes, its off-white shifting between bone, ivory and a faint lilac, like wet paint drying: a colour that doesn't exist. The woman and the man stand still at opposite ends, facing each other; only breath, a drip from her hem, the silk stirring. Neither steps closer. Faces unchanged, no talking, no new people, nothing appears on the wall.

title: Первоснежье
source_text: Здравствуй, друг, мне бы к тебе прикоснуться легонько, чуть-чуть, / Но так дорого стоит это тепло, выше всяких валют,
why: His breath at her nape never becomes a touch. She calls him 'friend', not lover, and prices the warmth above any currency, so recognition and the art-money world arrive in one breath.
what_we_see: Locked-off macro, no camera move. The body stays: both are still, and the gap between his face and her ear never closes; he does not touch her. Only his breath moves: the fine hairs at her nape and the loose strands by her ear stir with each slow exhale, and the tweed weave and lilac collar answer with the faintest lift. A faint warm heat-haze shimmers in the gap between them while the cool blue rim light slides slowly across her black hair. His lips stay parted and still, no speech, no kiss. Faces unchanged, no new people.

title: Вчерашний день
source_text: Поцелуя не жду. Губами / Расцелую я лед на стеклах.
why: This is her own image of the exact gesture: she expects no kiss, so she kisses the frost. The pride and loneliness are both here, and the ice returns as Ule's thawed tear at 24.
what_we_see: Slow push-in on her profile. Eyes stay closed. She leans the last centimetre, presses her lips softly to the frosted pane and holds; the clear oval around her mouth melts wider, beads of meltwater running down the glass; she eases back a breath's width and her exhale clouds the oval white again as frost creeps back. Outside, the blue-white streetlight blooms and softens like wet paint behind the frost. The face in the glass is only her own reflection and moves with her. No speaking, no other person, hair and jacket still, face unchanged.

title: Последняя Осень
source_text: А мне - благодать. Догорать. Догорать.
why: A single leaf with ember veins rises through the storm. Burning out reads as grace, not loss, and the line is short enough for a 4-second shot.
what_we_see: Generate the leaf FALLING (the edit plays it reversed so it rises): the single burnt leaf drifts slowly downward in a gentle spiral, turning on its stem, its veins glowing and dimming like embers as it turns through the light, lit as if through a plane window. The camera tilts down gently with it so it stays near frame centre. Storm clouds roll slowly; the city lights below twinkle softly; a breath of mist. One leaf only: no flames, no sparks, no second leaf, no birds, nothing new in the sky.

title: I'll Drown
source_text: One day I'll drown / In cool silence / And drift to sleep.
why: Kira's own verse from the novel. Her unblinking gaze, then the slip under, is drowning without panic, and 'cool silence' carries the contract's silence into the sea.
what_we_see: Overhead, locked-off, a very slow push-in toward her eyes. First 6 s: she floats near-still on the black sea, gaze into the lens, unblinking; only the water moves: slow swell, rings around her shoulders, wet curls fanning and drifting, the moon path above her breaking into silver brushstrokes. Then, without freezing, she tips her head back and slips under in one smooth motion; black water closes over her face with a real splash, hair last to vanish, rings spreading. The slip stays on. Face unchanged until it goes under, no talking, no one else.

title: Atuona Morning
source_text: Salt from yesterday's tears, today's sweat. / All the same ocean.
why: Water streams off her back as she rises with three feathers: grief and heat dissolve into one sea. It plants the salt that becomes Ule's tear trails at 25.
what_we_see: Behind her, locked-off, at water level. The body stays: she rises only a few centimetres out of the black water, water streaming off her shoulder blade in thin bright rivulets, droplets beading; one slow breath lifts her back. Exactly three wet white feathers stay clinging to her shoulder blade: never four, none falls. Wet curls drip and sway. The moonlit sea ripples in silver brushstrokes. She does not turn; we see only her back and shoulder. Hair colour and skin unchanged, no one else.

title: Азимут
source_text: Зря ты снова сбросил чешую / там, где я тихонечко взлетаю.
why: Pearl scales and a lone footprint holding the moon. Something was shed right where she quietly takes flight, which answers the feathers of 7m: drowning, then rebirth, then flight.
what_we_see: Low ground-level camera, a very slow slide toward the scales. Surf foam runs up the black sand and draws back, its thin silver edge stopping short of the scales. Moonlight shimmers on the sea; the scales glint, their mother-of-pearl colour shifting slowly from pearl to lilac to ice-blue as the light travels across them, like an Impressionist sea. The water in the footprint trembles and holds the moon. Palm fronds sway. The scales lie still: they do not crawl or slide. No person, no new footprints, no animals.

title: Digital Exile
source_text: Morning in Atuona doesn't begin with light. / It begins with scent.
why: One slow breath with lowered lids while the steam takes on a frangipani tint. Scent comes before light, exactly what the shot does.
what_we_see: Very slow push-in on her profile. The body stays: she draws one slow, deep breath through the nose, scent before light; nostrils and throat move, lids stay half-lowered, lips still, no speaking. Behind her, steam rises off the black sand and drifts across the jungle, catching a faint warm frangipani-pink and honey tint, as if the scent were visible. Water drops run slowly down her cheek and jaw; wet curls stir. Distant surf. No flower appears in her hair or anywhere, no one else on the beach, face unchanged.

title: Atuona Morning
source_text: Sheets stuck to skin like a second dress. / Through the shutters — Atuona morning, thick as honey. / The air tastes of frangipani and rust.
why: The honey stripe from the shutters on her shoulder, heat and half-open eyes: the frame in her own words. It is sensual without one explicit word, and 'rust' keeps it underground.
what_we_see: Locked-off. The body stays, the light moves: one thick honey-gold stripe from the shutters sweeps very slowly across her bare shoulder toward the shoulder blade, warming the skin as it passes, its edge soft and liquid like a brushstroke of honey; dust motes turn gold in the beam; a shutter swings gently outside and the slat shadows drift. She lies still, eyes half-open, one slow breath, at most one slow blink. The sheet stays exactly where it is. The faint forehead scar stays pale. No speaking, no one else, face unchanged.

title: Light Commits
source_text: The body stays. / The light moves.
why: The film's visual law spoken where it is most literally true: she does not move, the honey light does. It is calm and aphoristic, sized for 4.5 seconds.
what_we_see: Locked-off. The honey stripe of light slides slowly onto her shoulder blade and settles; the fine hairs on her skin light up gold and lift slightly, skin answering the air; one slow breath lifts and lowers her back. Eyes stay closed, lips parted and still. The sheet stays exactly where it is; nothing is pulled away and she stays face-down as framed. The light's edge is soft and liquid, like a brushstroke of honey. The faint forehead scar stays pale. No one else, face unchanged.

title: Апокалипсис
source_text: Ну же, с плеч приспусти бретели... / Ради Бога, не будь хладнокровна, / Убивая меня в постели!
why: The reflection draws a strap down while the woman in the red room stays frozen. In her poem it is Longing, a woman, who is told to undress, so the double dares what Kira holds back. It is never explicit, and Ule is absent.
what_we_see: Locked-off, a barely perceptible push-in toward the mirror. The woman in the room, back to us, does not move at all, her hand stays where it is. Only her reflection moves, slowly: its fingers draw one thin strap off the edge of the shoulder onto the upper arm, while the other hand stays pressed to the chest, holding the black silk fully in place; the bodice never drops. In the mirror it is daylight and palm leaves sway in a warm breeze; the room stays red-lamp night, lamp flames flickering. No lip movement, no speech, faces unchanged, no third woman.

title: Landing
source_text: He holds her waist like she's another lot with a pre-sale estimate.
why: His flat palm on Mila's waist as the couple walks the jetty toward Kira's shoulder, read as an auction appraisal. The market arrives with them.
what_we_see: Locked-off at Kira's shoulder. Mila and Jean-Marc walk slowly toward camera along the jetty, two or three unhurried steps; his flat palm stays on her waist, his eyes ahead; her knit dress sways at the slit. Kira, soft in the foreground, stays still, only her curls lifting in the wind. Behind the sharp people, the copper-rose sky and sea smear and shimmer like wet, unblended oil strokes in heat haze; the distant rain curtain drifts. The seaplane stays moored. Faces unchanged, smiles do not grow, no talking, no new people, no statue.

title: Ночные лисицы
source_text: Плачут ночные лисицы. / Слезы их мне знакомы.
why: Kira's held gaze in front while his ringed fingers tighten on Mila's wrist behind. Recognition between women, without a word: she knows these tears because they were hers.
what_we_see: Very slow push-in on Kira. She is near-still, gaze held, at most one slow blink; the narrow band of cool white-gold dawn light stays across her eyes and softly brightens, though nothing casts it, while the copper sunset warms the rest of her face. Behind, in soft focus, Jean-Marc's ringed fingers slowly close tighter on Mila's wrist above the gold bangle; Mila keeps her poised smile and stays still. The water glitters copper. The seaplane stays still. Faces unchanged, no talking, no new people, no added objects.

title: Guest
source_text: Навещу-ка ублюдков / Я непрошеным гостем,
why: An unhurried walk through the storm, eyes on the lens, into the dinner where the necklace waits. It is swagger at exactly target length, and her one profanity in the film, used as an entrance.
what_we_see: She walks slowly and steadily toward the camera between the tables, unhurried, eyes on the lens. Storm wind lifts the sheer jungle-print chiffon and streams the long sleeves sideways; palms bend; lantern flames flicker and swing on their hooks; light rain slants; surf rolls in behind. Impressionist: the lantern glow smears into the wet dusk like warm copper oil paint, the storm sky shimmering like a freshly painted canvas. Camera dollies back slowly at her walking pace, one continuous take.

title: Последняя Осень
source_text: Эти смыслы навечно срослись - эротика и активы, / Их - под лютый конвой - они целы и невредимы.
why: The clasp closes in lightning while she stares into the lens. Desire and capital are fused like the 'advance on the contract', and her composure stays 'whole and unharmed' under escort.
what_we_see: His fingers close the clasp at the back of her neck in one small precise movement, then lift slowly away and rest on her shoulders. She stays upright and still, eyes on the lens, only her breath moving under the necklace; the emeralds catch the lantern light. Rain falls in slow silver lines; lantern flames flicker; the lightning fades into a violet afterglow that pulses once across the wet tablecloth. Impressionist: rain-light runs over her skin like wet brushstrokes. Locked-off camera, then an almost imperceptible push-in on her face.

title: Инвентаризация тишины
source_text: Slowly killing the canvas from inside. Beauty with a self-destruct timer.
why: The craquelure at Mila's eye catches the sunset like old varnish while he studies her as a canvas: beauty failing from inside. It is sharp and stands alone.
what_we_see: Near-still. The low sun sinks: peach light slowly deepens to copper across her cheek, and as it travels the fine craquelure at the corner of her eye catches it with a dry golden glint, like old varnish under a gallery lamp. Waves roll in slowly on the black sand behind; a warm breeze lifts a few loose strands of her hair and stirs his locs; the frangipani petals tremble. He keeps studying her like a canvas, gaze steady. Camera: very slow push-in toward her eye.

title: Повремени
source_text: Ты как-то, детка, не случалась... / Случись теперь из западни.
why: Mila rises and shakes her colour onto the sand while his hand closes on air. The escape is spoken to her as a blessing: you never quite happened, so happen now, out of the trap.
what_we_see: She finishes rising slowly and brushes her white silk dress once; a soft plume of ultramarine pigment drifts down from it and settles over the black sand around her bare feet, glowing faintly like coloured dust in the dusk. His outstretched hand closes slowly on empty air. The silk sways in the night breeze; small waves wash in; the first stars stay sharp; the candle on the sofa table flickers. Camera locked, a slight drift toward his closing hand.

title: Cracks Around the Eyes
source_text: Mila caught his gaze and smiled slightly — that smile people wear when they've already decided on their own disappearance.
why: The woman in the window breathes in and out of transparency, looking back at us. It is the smile of someone who has already chosen to vanish, and it closes the arrival block.
what_we_see: Only light moves. The candle flame flickers, and with each flicker the woman in the window breathes faintly in and out of transparency like a reflection, then settles. Beyond the glass the night sea moves in slow ultramarine ripples; the far lights on the water shimmer. The black curls in the foreground stir with one slow breath. Camera locked-off.

title: Bird of Prosperity
source_text: Kira had to build a comfortable cage for two, step inside, sit down across from Him and look Him in the eyes.
why: The cage, the two facing chairs and the unblinking stare: her sobriety image, exactly at target length. 'Him' is the Beast, so Ule reads as an opponent across the table, never a lover.
what_we_see: They sit locked, staring at each other without blinking. The match burns steady and flickers at her open eye but never shortens. Crimson storm light pulses through the shutter slats and their bar-shadows slide slowly across faces, shoulders and hands: the body stays, the light moves. Rain beads run down the shutters; droplets glint on the cage bars. Only breath moves in their chests; his fingertips rest on her wrist. Camera locked-off, an imperceptible push-in.

title: Atuona
source_text: Повторяя глотки Килиана / Из пригоршней Её волос, / Я Ей, миленький, так и не стану.
why: Her perfume is visible as heat haze while he closes the clasp again. In the novel, Kilian is the scent he breathes in, and 'Her' keeps Kira's desire with women. 'I'll never become Her, darling' refuses him. It is the first of two stanzas from the title poem.
what_we_see: His fingers close the emerald clasp at the nape of her neck slowly, in one deliberate movement, then rest lightly on her skin. Her shoulders rise once with a slow breath; a water bead slides down her shoulder blade. The emeralds throw a faint green light that moves over her skin like light through sea water; above her shoulder the warm air trembles faintly, her perfume made visible as heat haze. The lamp behind flickers softly. Camera locked, slight push-in on the clasp.

title: Red Dog
source_text: Fact: dogs aren't red. / Fact: it has no shadow. / Fact: Gauguin never explained its meaning.
why: Hard noon, and she lifts her eyes to the empty beach where the shadowless red dog will be composited. Impossible facts, stated flatly, let the other reality in.
what_we_see: Hard white noon. Palm fronds sway in the trade wind and their black shadows shift on the sand; heat shimmer rises off the black sand so the air trembles like wet paint. Her curls lift a little in the wind; her dress hem stirs. She slowly lifts her eyes from the sand and looks across the empty beach to the right, then holds still. Camera locked-off, no movement at all (a figure is composited onto this plate in post).

title: The Secret Exhibition
source_text: Words that could never be printed. / Words that still haven’t been forgiven.
why: Her fingertips read the carved grooves in honey light. Gauguin's insults in the wood are still unforgiven. Exact length, and not the passage burned in film #8.
what_we_see: Her fingertips glide slowly a few centimetres along one carved groove, feeling it. The raking sunbeam travels across the relief like slow honey, deepening and lifting the shadows inside the grooves as it moves. Dust motes drift through the beam; the curtains at the back breathe in a faint draft. Camera: slow push-in toward her fingertips.

title: The Yellow Christ
source_text: Like the keyboard of Cursor at three in the morning when code is no longer code but the continuation of a vein.
why: Cool light slides along the vein where code is composited: her code is her bloodstream. The carving of 18 passes into her own medium.
what_we_see: The forearm lies still. A cool blue-white light slides slowly along the inside of the arm from elbow to wrist, following the vein; the water beads glint as it passes; the fine hairs stir in a breath of air. The blue vein line shimmers faintly, like ink spreading in wet paper. A barely visible pulse at the wrist. Camera locked-off (code is composited along the vein in post).

title: Fear of Collectors
source_text: The hall reeks of expensive perfume and fear. Yes, fear – she's learned to smell it over the years.
why: She sits still in the third row while the paddles drift like a tide and bleed crimson. What she smells in the room is fear dressed as money. It echoes the perfume of 16b and M2's 'knows how it smells'.
what_we_see: She sits still in the third row, eyes on the lens, only her breath moving. Around her the raised white paddles drift slowly in the dark like a tide; on each, a soft crimson light spreads over the white face and fades, like red ink in snow. Wet hair and skin glint; the aisle lights flicker and their reflections tremble on the wet floor. Camera: slow push-in on her face.

title: Русый хвост
source_text: Я тебя не найду: страждет холст под невзрачною маской...
why: Gauguin's colours surface in the stained plaster under Ule's palm, then sink back: a canvas suffering under a drab mask, and a search that will not end in finding.
what_we_see: He keeps his palm flat on the wall, looking back over his shoulder, still. Leaf shadows sway slowly across the plaster; dust drifts through the sunbeam. Under his hand the stained plaster slowly warms with faint Gauguin colours (ochre, rose, deep green) blooming in the stains like a fresco surfacing, then sinking back. His linen shirt stirs with a slow breath. Camera: very slow push-in.

title: Алгоритм голода
source_text: В животе засосало. Не от голода — от узнавания.
why: From the notebook chapter itself: as she draws the swollen notebook out of the light, the gut drops. 'Not from hunger — from recognition' brings the film's key word in through the body.
what_we_see: Her hand tilts the swollen black notebook slowly up into the shaft of light so the scratches on its cover catch it like an old scar, then draws it a little toward her, out of the light. Dust motes fall slowly through the beam; cobwebs sway; the light through the broken boards above flickers faintly, as if someone walks overhead. Camera: slow push-in on the cover.

title: The Second PA
source_text: We manage to be liars in simple answers.
why: Ule alone at the rain window right after her spoken 'No. Nothing.' The lie is named as something they both know how to do. A sharp turn, the low point before the tears.
what_we_see: Ule stands at the open night window, still, not turning; lips closed, no speech, no head turn. Only his chest breathes slowly. Fine rain falls beyond the palm fronds; one wet frond sways a little; the far lights on the black bay tremble and smear into soft impressionist strokes on the water. The oil-lamp flame flickers, its honey glow breathing on his shoulder and jaw. His reflection in the casement glass stays locked to him; raindrops trickle down the pane. Nobody enters. Camera locked-off, a barely perceptible push-in.

title: Мужчины не плачут
source_text: "Не заплачу никогда...", / Но слеза вдруг до упора / Жмет на тормоз разговора / Струйкой стаявшего льда.
why: From her poem 'Men Don't Cry': one tear wells on a still face and the vow breaks without a sob. The tear is thawed ice, closing the frost-kiss circle from 2, at target length.
what_we_see: Extreme close-up, Ule's wet face perfectly still, eyes open and glistening on the lens; mouth closed and unmoving, no sobbing, no frown change, no fluttering blinks. One new tear slowly wells and runs down the existing trail on his cheek; older trails dry to fine white salt. His chest rises once, slowly. The warm lamp bokeh behind him pulses gently like candle flame, and a faint cool shimmer, like light through melting ice, slides slowly across his cheekbone. Face shape and identity unchanged. Camera locked, no push.

title: Three Notes
source_text: Salt left white trails on his skin — like maps of countries that don't exist.
why: Her fingertip travels the white salt line as if reading a map. Tenderness that reads grief, not romance; the salt planted at 7m comes home.
what_we_see: Macro, no eyes, no mouth. Her fingertip travels very slowly along the thin white salt trail on his cheek, a few millimetres only, as if reading a map; his skin and stubble stay still. Sweat beads glint. The crimson lamp behind breathes softly; red light pulses over the skin like a slow heartbeat, its edge bleeding warm like watercolour. The salt stays a fine white line, never blood or a cut. No face turns into frame, no second hand appears, nothing added. Camera macro, locked, a slow slight push-in.

title: Nocturnal Silence
source_text: Palm still on Ule’s chest. / Under the skin — steady pulse. / Not consensus. / Just proof that the chain still holds.
why: Her palm flat on his chest under drifting moon-lace, the pulse at his throat, both gazes on the lens. It is proof of life, explicitly 'not consensus': two damaged people seen, not seduced.
what_we_see: Locked-off. Both faces stay still, gazes held on the lens, lips closed, no fluttering blinks, no head turns, no kiss. The carved moonlight lace from the window drifts very slowly across his face, chest and her fingers, as if clouds pass the moon, breathing brighter and dimmer like brushwork. Her palm rests flat on his chest; her fingertips move a millimetre, reading the light like braille. A steady pulse shows at his throat; his chest rises once. One wet curl of hers stirs. The moon shimmers. His shirt opens no further. Nothing added.

title: Сгоревший
source_text: И ни со зла, и никак. / Просто некая точность - / Словно старый наждак, / Мне истерший кожу.
why: One fingertip traces the pale healed scar: a precision that hurts without malice, skin worn smooth like old sandpaper. Tactile and exact; not the #024 lines used in film #7.
what_we_see: Macro, no face. The man's fingertip glides very slowly down along the pale hairline scar, a short way only, barely pressing. Her back stays still except one slow breath lifting the shoulder blades. The single black curl stirs; one water bead slides slowly down the skin. Soft honey side-light travels slowly across her back, the shadow between the shoulder blades softening like wet paint. The scar stays faint, pale, healed, skin-toned: never red, raw, bleeding or a wound. No second hand, no turning, nothing added. Camera locked, macro.

title: Stillness
source_text: silence is not the absence of sound. / It is when both know what to say and choose not to.
why: His lips form words under her two fingers that never sound. This is her own definition of the film's silence, and it answers the swallowed scream of 1a. Non-explicit lines.
what_we_see: Macro, near-still. His lips move only faintly under her two fingers, as if forming words that never sound: mouth stays almost closed, no opening, no teeth, no kissing or taking her fingers. Her fingers rest lightly and stay where they are. One slow breath through his nose; his chest rises once. Behind, faint smoke drifts, the two lamps flicker, the red jungle flowers barely stir; the crimson light on her fingers pulses softly, as if with his unspoken words. No eyes enter frame, nothing added. Camera locked.

title: Прохлада
source_text: Будто бы в преисподней ждет нас один пароль.
why: His name is voiced off-face while her breath brightens the lilac light on his throat. A name as the one password waiting in the underworld: a key, not a plea.
what_we_see: Near-still. Her lips stay parted and motionless: no speaking, no mouth movement (his name is voiced off-face). She does not move closer; her lips never touch his skin, no kiss. He stays utterly still, head back against the carving, eyes open; only his throat moves with one slow breath. The small pool of cool lilac-white dawn light on his throat slowly breathes brighter where her breath falls, then softens; no mist, no frost. The crimson and honey bars from the low slats shimmer like heat. Wet curls stir. Her strap stays up. Camera locked, very slow push-in.

title: Stillness
source_text: Ule does not kiss. / He looks.
why: His hand stopped in the air at her jaw, sea-light ending at his fingertips. The film's rule, recognition not seduction, said at its most tempting moment: no kiss, only looking.
what_we_see: Near-still take, not a freeze. Ule kneels perfectly still, his hand stopped in the air at her jaw: it does not move closer or stroke; eyes locked on hers, no blinking; only his chest barely rises. Kira stays still, bare back to camera, never turning toward it; the crimson silk at her waist stays in place; one slow breath in her shoulders. The rippling aquamarine sea-light net drifts slowly over him alone and stops at his fingertips; she stays in crimson. In the window the storm sea rolls, one far lightning flicker. No kiss, no lean-in. Camera locked.

title: Nocturnal Silence
source_text: Where it is no longer possible to lie to yourself.
why: His hand presses her palm to his pulse. This is the place where lying stops, and it answers the lie of 22.
what_we_see: Macro, no faces. His hand presses her palm a little closer to his throat, slowly, once, and holds. Under her spread fingers his pulse beats softly and steadily; his jaw and throat otherwise still. Sweat beads glint. In the empty salon behind, haze drifts slowly through the sconce light, and the warm sconce glow pulses softly like a heartbeat. Each hand keeps five fingers, no merging, no sliding. No one enters, nothing added. Camera locked, macro.

title: The Yellow Christ
source_text: Ule places his palm on the small of her back. / Not a lover. A witness.
why: His palm rests on the small of her back as they face the lilac dawn. Her own line names the relationship once and for all: not a lover, a witness.
what_we_see: Near-still. Both stand looking out to sea, no speaking, no lip movement; neither turns to the other. Ule's palm stays resting on the small of her back: no stroking, no pulling her closer, no embrace. Wind lifts strands of Kira's black curls and his loose hair; their shirts stir slightly. The red dog sits still, only an ear twitches; no shadow appears under it. The lilac surf rolls in slowly and slides back; mist drifts along the jungle ridge. The lilac-pink dawn slowly blooms across the clouds and wet sand like a Monet sky. Camera: a barely perceptible lateral drift.

title: Quantum Shift
source_text: Wave. Particle. Wave. Particle.
why: Two Kiras in one composite: one woman in two states at once, in the rhythm of the surf. It reads as glitch, not as a caption of what we already see.
what_we_see: Composite built from shot 36: the same woman shown twice, two versions of her on the black sand by the foam ring.

title: Atuona
source_text: Закольцуешься чьим-то мужем. / Я останусь: ничьей женой, / Атуоной, горбатой старушкой / В целом с Богом и чуть - с Сатаной.
why: She steps out of the closed ring of foam. 'You'll ring yourself in as someone's husband; I remain nobody's wife, Atuona' is the last stanza of the title poem over the title shot: self-possessed, with God and a little with Satan.
what_we_see: Kira walks slowly toward the camera out of the closed ring of white foam, two unhurried barefoot steps; her face stays exactly the same, calm, eyes on the lens, lips closed, no speaking (the voice is off-face). Wet black curls and the dark linen dress move gently with her steps; the dress stays opaque. Behind her the foam ring stays closed and empty, its lace fizzing and sinking into the black sand, glowing faintly lilac like a brushstroke. The sea breathes in thin sheets; mist drifts in the jungle. Camera: high angle, slow pull-back at her pace, the empty ring kept in frame.

title: Подмостки
source_text: Все закончится одиночеством. / Снова. / И с него же начнется.
why: Foam whitens the black sand, draws back, and the sand is black again. An ending that is also a beginning, which loops the film back to the silence of 1a.
what_we_see: No people. Top-down on black volcanic sand at lilac dawn. One slow thin sheet of white foam slides up over the black sand, whitening it, pauses, then draws back, bubbles fizzing and popping slowly, and the sand is black and gleaming again. The lilac light on the foam shimmers like wet paint and fades as it retreats. Tiny glints in the wet sand. Camera locked, top-down, no movement. Nothing added: no footprints, no people, no shells, no objects, no text.
